market.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (research/educational use; see docs/dataset_notes.md)

primary_sheet.note: No labels yet: the sheet is empty until a human reviews it. No metrics were computed.

limitations: Metrics describe this labelled sample only; they are not an estimate for future articles.
200 row(s) in the sheet are unreviewed and were excluded, not counted as correct.
Labelled articles come from one publisher category, so the sample is not representative of all news.
Classification uses the headline (or headline+description) only; body text is not available in this dataset.
Per-class numbers for classes with few labels are unstable; treat small-support rows as indicative only.
This is a baseline, not a validated model: a result close to the naive baseline is a valid outcome to report.
next_step: Label data/annotations/news_review_sample.csv by hand (rules: docs/annotation_guidelines.md), then re-run this command to compute precision/recall/F1. Phase 3 comes after that.
